versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Session Initialization" section guiding users to check for `~/.polygon-agent/builder.json` and export `accessKey` before running any commands.
- Provided explicit instructions for setting required environment variables from the file, enhancing first-run and recovery flows.
- Clarified what to do if setup has not been completed, pointing users directly to Phase 1.
- No changes to CLI commands or core behaviors; all modifications are documentation/usage guidance improvements.

polygon-agents-cli 1.0.3

- Updated project name and description for improved clarity and consistency
- Documentation now recommends running via npx instead of global npm install
- Minor wording edits for accuracy and user guidance throughout setup and command usage
- Added Troubleshooting section placeholder at the end of documentation
- updated to use npx commands

- Package renamed from `polygon-agent-kit` to `polygon-agent-cli`
- Global install command updated to `npm install -g @polygonlabs/agent-cli`
- Node.js 22+ is now required (was Node.js 20+)
- Entry point for setup now uses `polygon-agent` directly (removed direct Node script usage)
- Documentation and install instructions updated for new package and CLI name; core commands and architecture remain unchanged

polygon-agent-kit 1.0.1

- Updated documentation with a new SKILL.md describing prerequisites, setup flow, key behaviors, and troubleshooting.
- Detailed commands reference for wallet creation, funding, token operations, swaps, deposits, agent registration, reputation, and micropayments.
- Improved user guidance on environment variables, critical wallet approval URL handling, and callback/tunnel mechanisms.
- Clarified default behaviors: dry-run mode, fee preferences, and session permission logic.
- Provided troubleshooting tips and fallback instructions for manual session recovery.
